## Checklist

Everything under `examples/` is public on the documentation site once merged.

- [ ] Placeholders only: `Your Company`, `123 Example St`, `Anytown, FL 00000`, `EX-001`, `PERMIT-000000` (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] No real names, addresses, parcel, permit, project or phone numbers, emails, logos, photos, aerials or tax maps.
- [ ] Built and audited clean: `python scripts/check_examples.py`, `python -m unittest discover -s tests`, `python scripts/build_examples.py`.
- [ ] Preview pictures regenerated with `print.py --png` for any example or kit change that alters a sheet.
